traditionalItems.title: Manual, Error-Prone Field Tickets
traditionalItems.description: Most field tickets are written by hand or in spreadsheets. They're often submitted late, contain mistakes, and are hard to verify.

traditionalItems.title: Disconnected Tools and Software
traditionalItems.description: Field data is scattered across different tools with no central platform. GPS, sensors, and logs operate in silos, making it difficult to track and manage operations in real time.

traditionalItems.title: Delayed Incident Detection
traditionalItems.description: Issues like spills, equipment faults, or boundary breaches are often discovered late—after damage is done and risks increase.

oversiteItems.title: Auto-Generated, GPS-Verified Field Logs
oversiteItems.description: Field tickets are automatically generated and location-stamped. This improves accuracy, speeds up processing, and reduces fraud.

oversiteItems.title: One Connected AI Platform
oversiteItems.description: All field data flows into one platform that brings everything together. GPS, sensors, and compliance logs are synced in real time and easy to monitor and manage.

oversiteItems.title: Instant Detection of Spills and Violations
oversiteItems.description: AI and sensors detect issues as they happen and alert the right people immediately—reducing risk, preventing damage, and ensuring compliance.
